question.text:
Let $T \& U$ be the set of all orthogonal matrices of order 3 over $R \&$ the set of all non-singular matrices of order 3 over $\mathrm{R}$ respectively
Let $A=\{-1,0,1\}$, then

options.text: there exists bijective mapping between $\mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{T}, \mathrm{U}$.
there does not exist bijective mapping between $\mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{T}, \mathrm{U}$.
there exists bijective mapping between $\mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{T}$ but not between $\mathrm{A} \& \mathrm{U}$.
there exists bijective mapping between $\mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{U}$ but not between $\mathrm{A} \& \mathrm{~T}$.
